Step 1

Block C, chair 4

Without checking every chair.

🎦

Cinema. Block C chair 4 = grid[2][3] backstage (zero-based!). Balconies differ in length — each row is its OWN array, so jagged rows are legal.

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int[][] seats = {{1, 0, 1}, {0, 1, 1}}; // 1 = free
    System.out.println("seat[0][1] = " + seats[0][1]);
    System.out.println("size = " + seats.length + "x" + seats[0].length);
    int free = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < seats.length; r++) {
      for (int c = 0; c < seats[r].length; c++) {
        if (seats[r][c] == 1) free++;
      }
    }
    System.out.println("free = " + free);
  }
}

Two-number addressing + nested count of free seats.
